slot.brief: Arrange four/five words in dictionary order and identify the first, second or last word as per the question.

stem:
Which of the following words will come fourth in the English dictionary?
Fable, Fabric, Facade, Facial, Factor

verdicts.working: Alphabetical order: Fable, Fabric, Facade, Facial, Factor. The fourth word is Facial.

working:
Dictionary order: Fable, Fabric, Facade, Facial, Factor. (Fable precedes Fabric as 'b-l' < 'b-r'.) Hence the fourth word is Facial. Facade is third, Factor fifth, Fabric second, so none of the other options is fourth.

Independent check: Alphabetical order: Fable, Fabric, Facade, Facial, Factor. The fourth word is Facial.
solution:
Comparing the words alphabetically gives: Fable, Fabric, Facade, Facial, Factor.
Hence, the fourth word is Facial.
